(c) Timing (committer dates, registry repo): runbook draft 84a8a3e @2026-08-08T16:35:37Z → human review a8ea70f @2026-08-09T00:33:17Z → receipt written @00:47:16.594Z (disk mtime == completedAt; runtime/ gitignored) → execution record de4aec0 @00:51:49Z. Human review precedes test execution. (d) Scope decision recorded live in outbox/claude-bridge/20260809-deploy-shadow-execution.md §2: human approved 'run tests, fill receipt', then approved scoped receipt '6 all-green critical suites (41/0), failing test recorded as debt, not fabricated'. (e) Receipt tamper-evident: write-release-test-receipt.mjs @ fb7747f binds gitCommit+command+passed+failed+completedAt into bodyHash a10f72a1...; on-disk sha256 abe90b90...
